description: This file defines the main activity for an Android news reader app. It manages UI layout modes (single-pane or dual-pane), handles navigation and category selection, manages fragment interactions for headlines and articles, and sets up the Action Bar with tabs or a list. It responds to user interactions such as selecting headlines or categories, and maintains state across configuration changes.

classes.name: NewsReaderActivity
classes.description: Main activity that manages the news headlines and articles display, action bar setup, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout, fragments, action bar, and user interface components.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Restores current category and article selection from saved instance state.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Handles restoring activity state after configuration changes.

methods.name: setUpActionBar
methods.description: Configures the Action Bar with tabs or list navigation depending on the device capabilities.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the default news category when the activity starts.

methods.name: setNewsCategory
methods.description: Updates the headlines fragment and article display based on the selected category.

methods.name: onHeadlineSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection of a headline, displaying the article either in a fragment or launching a new activity.

methods.name: onCategorySelected
methods.description: Handles category selection from the Action Bar, updating the current category.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for category selection button in non-Action Bar UI.
